task_text: Get all four plastic bottles into the bin -- throw them in or put them in. Success: all 4 bottles are inside the bin at the same time: each bottle's centre of mass within the bin's inner wall radius of the bin's axis, not below the bin's floor, and at most about one bottle length (~0.11 m) above its rim (a bottle may still be held). The goal must hold for 30 consecutive control steps (1.02 s); the episode then ends in success.
